title: hazrate kulsoom binte fatima paida hui
body:
hazrate kulsoom binte fatima paida hui
doosri shere quda ki dilruba paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
shor hai salwaat ka ghul hai mubarakbaad ka
noore chashme mustafa salle alaa paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
saanie zainab fidaai shabbaro shabbir ki
haamie dee'n shaafaye roze jaza paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan me dekar nawaasi ke azaa'n qush hai nabi
qush abutalib hai poti mailaqa paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
hoke qush farmate hai maadar se ye hasnain aaj
doosri qaahar ba fazle kibriya paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar zainab behen ko hoke qush kehti hai ye
quwwate baazu meri shukre quda paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
haq se baqshaaenge ye shehzaade aur shehzaadia'n
maghferat ko sabki aale mustafa paida hui
<<DIVIDER>>
naaznee'n ye maa ki hai aur baap ki hai laadli
haq ki pyaari qalq ki haajat rawa paida hui
